mandate: Owner 2026-10-17: "Why can't I go from a selected comment in Review to see it in Discuss easily?" Answer the why; add Show in Discuss from Review (card menus, context menu, line with a thread, a key in the BPR-1567 catalogue) and the reverse; outdated, PR-level and draft cases; core decides, Qt presents. Coordinator additions: BPR-1582 Threads click selects, double click Review, Shift+double click Discuss, Review chip, row menu with Mark as read/unread; BPR-1584 one reading width setting for Threads and Discuss (owner: not for ultra-wide removal; make it a setting; never the code comparison). One Accept/Reject per card in one fresh short session; frame sequence Light/Dark; do not merge before acceptance.

decisions.keys: Ctrl+Alt+3 (Option-Command-3) Show the selected thread in Discuss, beside Command-3; Ctrl+Alt+2 (Option-Command-2) back, beside Command-2. Both step aside while typing (AltGr on Windows). Catalogue entries show_in_discuss/show_in_review; resident menu bar mirrors.
decisions.route: core::route_workbench_thread gains Origin, OnFile, Placed; reasons draft_opens_in_composer, not_on_a_file, opens_without_a_line; Available and Composer. core::choose_workbench_thread_target picks open thread at picked post, else current at selected post, else the selected line's (line first with the code focused).
decisions.arrival: cards view mark_arrival: post wash stronger with an amber ring, held 0.7 s, dissolving 0.65 s to the resting pick wash (QVariantAnimation, dissolve not motion).
decisions.behaviour_change: Discuss's Open in Review is enabled for an outdated/unanchored thread on a file (opens among the file's unplaced threads); BPR-1383/1384 tests updated. Review's post reader menu is now the native menu extended (set_extended_menu) with Show in Discuss.
decisions.mark_unread: core::mark_conversation_unread moves the seen cursor before the latest post by someone else; review_ledger_application_host::mark_conversation_unread via shared store_conversation_receipt; github_application mark_conversation_unread wired as window set_conversation_unread_dispatch (src/app changed).
decisions.reading_width: core::reading_width {narrow 960, medium 1600, wide 2560 default, full}; review_behaviour_settings.ReadingWidth; workbench settings schema 22 column reading_width DEFAULT 2; Settings > Reviews & queue > Reading row 10; finder rows and Discuss panel max width; comparison untouched (tested at 3440).
